from solution import remove_lowercase


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Remove lowercase substrings as in example 'KDeoALOklOOHserfLoAJSIskdsf'."""
    assert remove_lowercase('KDeoALOklOOHserfLoAJSIskdsf') == 'KDALOOOHLAJSI'  # 27-14=13


def test_issue_all_lowercase_empty():
    """Remove lowercase substrings leaving empty string when all lowercase."""
    assert remove_lowercase('abcdefxyz') == ''  # 9-9=0


def test_issue_all_uppercase_unchanged():
    """Remove lowercase substrings keeping all uppercase unchanged."""
    assert remove_lowercase('ABCXYZ') == 'ABCXYZ'  # 6-0=6


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Remove lowercase substrings from empty string stays empty."""
    assert remove_lowercase('') == ''  # 0-0=0


def test_issue_digits_symbols_unchanged():
    """Remove lowercase substrings keeping digits and symbols unchanged."""
    assert remove_lowercase('123!@#456') == '123!@#456'  # 9-0=9


def test_issue_mixed_letters_digits():
    """Remove lowercase substrings keeping uppercase and digits."""
    assert remove_lowercase('ABCabc123') == 'ABC123'  # 9-3=6


def test_issue_spaces_preserved():
    """Remove lowercase substrings preserving spaces."""
    assert remove_lowercase('Hello World') == 'H W'  # 11-8=3


def test_issue_lowercase_at_both_ends():
    """Remove lowercase substrings at both ends keeping middle uppercase."""
    assert remove_lowercase('abcABCabc') == 'ABC'  # 9-6=3


def test_issue_single_lowercase():
    """Remove lowercase substrings for single lowercase char."""
    assert remove_lowercase('a') == ''  # 1-1=0


def test_issue_single_uppercase():
    """Remove lowercase substrings keeping single uppercase char."""
    assert remove_lowercase('Z') == 'Z'  # 1-0=1


def test_contract_returns_string_value():
    """Function remove_lowercase(str1) returns a string value."""
    assert remove_lowercase('AbC') == 'AC'  # 3-1=2


def test_contract_input_unchanged():
    """Function does not mutate its string argument."""
    s = 'AbC'  # 3-1=2 for return value
    remove_lowercase(s)  # call once
    assert s == 'AbC'  # 3-0=3 unchanged
